# iris-lab

> A pinned-version local image-generation experiment around antirez/iris.c. Research and design are present; the wrapper and runtime acceptance are pending.

Tier: ungraded
Status: spec-only
Interfaces: spec
Entrypoint: https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/iris-lab/SDD.md
Auth: none
Spec: none — machine-readable invocation schemas are planned for M1; the current SDD is prose.

The planned first runtime path is Apple Silicon Metal with FLUX.2 Klein 4B distilled, one local txt2img job at a time. No callable iris-lab CLI, service, GPU benchmark or usable release is provided yet. Long-term investment remains unassigned. The engine and model revisions are pinned separately; model bytes have not been downloaded or verified.

## Interface reference

- [SDD](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/iris-lab/SDD.md): proposed request, result, error and reproducibility contracts; commands are not implemented.
- [SUCCESS](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/iris-lab/SUCCESS.md): document milestone evidence and pending runtime acceptance.

## Optional

- [Platforms and models](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/iris-lab/docs/platform-models.md): supported upstream architectures, backend dependencies and unverified lab paths.
- [Sources](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/iris-lab/docs/sources.md): official documentation and supplementary tutorials, with dates and limitations.
- [Verification plan](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/iris-lab/docs/verification-plan.md): future real-hardware checks and required evidence.
- [Lock metadata](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/labs/iris-lab/upstream.lock.json): researched revisions, not a verified model download manifest.
